card.name: Last piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a brand drug name split into several parts, such as the QUE in RASONQUE or the I in POMBILITI. It also fires on a few odd spots inside capitalized abbreviations.

modes.label: End of brand name
modes.description: The closing piece of an uppercase or capitalized brand name in dosing and adverse reaction text.
modes.example: Withhold, reduce the dose, or permanently discontinue RASON<<QUE>> based on severity

modes.label: Odd capitalized fragments
modes.description: Single letters or short pieces inside capitalized abbreviations or shouted phrases.
modes.example: IF CONTACT<< DOES>> OCCUE WITH EYES, RIN

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of a newly split brand drug name, mostly when the name is written in capitals.
